title: M3 Canonical Control Room - truthful operator journeys
description: Build the board, graph, approvals, evidence, recovery, doctor, accessibility, and J1-J6 journey surfaces from generated daemon contracts.
architectureNotes: Matches design Phase 6 and the pinned control-room spec. Product decision 2026-08-07: apps/control-room is the canonical standalone React local application, connected to the daemon through generated authenticated HTTP/query contracts and a resumable cursor stream. IDE adapters are optional thin discover/start/open/embed-or-browser-fallback shells; they own no lifecycle, authority, state, or duplicate UI behavior. The committed control-room-model package is presentation-only and must never compute authority. UI implementation waits for durable projections and nextAllowedCommands.

Development happens only in D:/projexts/moe-next; do not create sibling Git worktrees. Runtime workspace isolation promised by the design remains in scope.
Preserve foreign work; stage and commit only explicit owned paths. Never use git add -A, implicit push, implicit merge, reset, or stash.
Fail closed with stable reason codes; missing or unverifiable evidence stays UNKNOWN and never gains authority.
Use TDD. Keep each production source focused, target <=250 lines, and split before 400 lines. No debug, probe, scratch, or generated evidence files may remain in commits.
